questions.questionText: Pointing to a photograph of a boy, Suresh says, "He is the only son of my mother's only son." How is Suresh related to the boy?
questions.explanation: "My mother's only son" refers to Suresh himself (since he is male). "The only son of Suresh" means the boy is Suresh's son. Therefore, Suresh is the father of the boy.

questions.questionText: A is the brother of B. B is the daughter of C. D is the father of C. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: B is the daughter of C, and A is the brother of B; therefore, A is the son of C. Since D is the father of C, A is the son of D's child, which makes A the grandson of D.

questions.questionText: Introducing a woman, a man said, "Her mother is the only daughter of my mother-in-law." How is the man related to the woman?
questions.explanation: "The only daughter of my mother-in-law" is the man's wife. The woman's mother is the man's wife. Therefore, the man is the father of the woman.

questions.questionText: If A + B means A is the brother of B; A - B means A is the sister of B; A * B means A is the father of B. Which expression means P is the nephew of Q?
questions.optionC: Q + R * P (where P is male)
questions.explanation: If Q + R, Q is the brother of R. If R * P, R is the father of P. If P is male, P is the son of Q's brother, which makes P the nephew of Q.

questions.questionText: P is the father of Q and the grandfather of R, who is the brother of S. S's mother, T, is married to V. If V is the brother of Q, how is T related to P?
questions.explanation: P is the grandfather of R and S. S's mother T is married to V. V is the brother of Q, so V is the son of P. Since T is married to P's son V, T is P's daughter-in-law.

questions.questionText: Pointing to a gentleman, Deepak said, "His only brother is the father of my daughter's father." Who is the gentleman to Deepak?
questions.explanation: "My daughter's father" is Deepak himself. "The father of Deepak" is Deepak's father. The gentleman's only brother is Deepak's father. Therefore, the gentleman is the brother of Deepak's father, which makes him Deepak's uncle (paternal uncle).

questions.questionText: In a family of six persons (A, B, C, D, E, F), there are two married couples. D is the grandmother of A and mother of B. C is the wife of B and mother of F. E is the granddaughter of D. How is F related to A?
questions.explanation: D is the grandmother of A and mother of B. C is married to B. C is the mother of F. Thus B and C are parents of F. Since D is grandmother of A and mother of B, A is also a child of B and C. Therefore, F and A are siblings (brother or sister).

questions.questionText: Looking at a portrait, Anita said, "He is the son of the only son of my grandfather." How is the person in the portrait related to Anita?
questions.explanation: "My grandfather's only son" is Anita's father. The person in the portrait is the son of Anita's father, which means he is Anita's brother.

questions.questionText: If P is the husband of Q, and R is the mother of S and Q, how is R related to P?
questions.explanation: P is married to Q (Q is wife). R is the mother of Q. The mother of a person's wife is their mother-in-law. Therefore, R is P's mother-in-law.

questions.questionText: A and B are married. C is the father of A. D is the sister of B. E is the mother of D. How is C related to E?
questions.explanation: A and B are married. C is father of A, and E is mother of B (since B and D are sisters). C and E are the respective parents of the married couple A and B.

questions.questionText: Pointing to a lady in the park, Naman said, "She is the daughter of my grandmother's only child." How is the lady related to Naman?
questions.explanation: "My grandmother's only child" is Naman's parent (mother or father). The daughter of Naman's parent is Naman's sister. Therefore, the lady is Naman's sister.

questions.questionText: A man said to a lady, "Your mother's husband's sister is my aunt." How is the lady related to the man?
questions.explanation: "Your mother's husband" is the lady's father. "Her father's sister" is the lady's paternal aunt. If that same person is the man's aunt, the lady and the man share the same paternal aunt and father, meaning the lady is the man's sister.

questions.questionText: If M @ N means M is the mother of N; M # N means M is the father of N; M $ N means M is the brother of N. What does expression A # B $ C @ D indicate about the relationship between A and D?
questions.optionA: A is the paternal grandfather of D
questions.optionB: A is the father of D
questions.optionC: A is the uncle of D
questions.optionD: A is the maternal grandfather of D
questions.explanation: A # B (A is father of B). B $ C (B is brother of C, so A is also father of C). C @ D (C is mother of D). Since C is D's mother and A is C's father, A is the maternal grandfather of D.

questions.questionText: Rahul and Robin are brothers. Pramod is Robin's father. Sheela is Pramod's sister. Preeti is Sheela's daughter. How is Rahul related to Preeti?
questions.explanation: Pramod is the father of Rahul and Robin. Sheela is Pramod's sister (Rahul's paternal aunt). Preeti is Sheela's daughter. The children of siblings are cousins. Hence, Rahul and Preeti are cousins.

questions.questionText: A family consists of two grandparents, two parents, and three grandchildren. What is the minimum number of people in this family?
questions.explanation: Two grandparents (1 grandfather, 1 grandmother = 2). Two parents (1 father, 1 mother = 2, who are the children of the grandparents). Three grandchildren (3 children = 3). Total = 2 + 2 + 3 = 7 people.

questions.questionText: Pointing to a boy, Meena says, "He is the son of the sister of my mother's brother." How is the boy related to Meena?
questions.explanation: "My mother's brother" is Meena's maternal uncle. "The sister of my mother's brother" can either be Meena's mother herself or Meena's maternal aunt. If she is Meena's mother, the boy is Meena's brother; if she is maternal aunt, the boy is Meena's cousin.

questions.questionText: K is the brother of T. M is the sister of K. W is the brother of Z. Z is the daughter of T. How is M related to Z?
questions.explanation: Z is the daughter of T. K is the brother of T, and M is the sister of K, which means M is also the sister of T. The sister of one's parent is one's aunt. Therefore, M is Z's aunt.

questions.questionText: If "P - Q" means P is the mother of Q; "P + Q" means P is the husband of Q; "P * Q" means P is the sister of Q. Which of the following means K is the father-in-law of H?
questions.optionA: K + L - M and H is married to M
questions.explanation: If K is married to L (K + L), and L is the mother of M (L - M), then K is the father of M. If H is married to M, then K is the father-in-law of H.

questions.questionText: A woman introduces a man as the son of the brother of her mother. How is the man related to the woman?
questions.explanation: "The brother of her mother" is her maternal uncle. The son of her maternal uncle is her cousin.

questions.questionText: In a family, B is the son of C but C is not the mother of B. How is C related to B?
questions.explanation: If B is the biological child (son) of C, and C is not the mother, C must be the father.

questions.questionText: Pointing to a girl, Divya said, "She is the daughter of the only child of my father." How is Divya related to the girl, assuming Divya is female?
questions.explanation: Since Divya is female, "the only child of my father" refers to Divya herself. The girl is the daughter of Divya, so Divya is her mother.

questions.questionText: P is the brother of Q. R is the daughter of Q. S is the sister of P. How is S related to R?
questions.explanation: P, Q, and S are siblings. Since R is the child of Q, S is the sister of R's parent, making S the aunt of R.

questions.questionText: If "A % B" means A is the son of B; "A & B" means A is the wife of B; "A ^ B" means A is the sister of B. In the expression X & Y % Z ^ W, how is Z related to Y?
questions.explanation: X & Y (X is wife of Y). Y % Z (Y is son of Z). Z ^ W (Z is sister of W, so Z is female). Since Y is the son of female Z, Z is the mother of Y.

questions.questionText: A man introduces a boy as the son of his wife's only brother. How is the boy related to the man?
questions.explanation: "His wife's only brother" is the man's brother-in-law. The son of a brother-in-law is a nephew.

questions.questionText: There are 6 members in a family: A, B, C, D, E, F. B is the son of D. D is the sister of C. E is the mother of D. A is the husband of E. How is A related to B?
questions.explanation: B is the son of D. E is the mother of D, and A is the husband of E (so A is the father of D). The father of one's mother is one's maternal grandfather. Hence A is the grandfather of B.

questions.questionText: Showing a man a photograph, a woman said, "His mother is the only daughter of my father." How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: "The only daughter of my father" is the woman herself. The man's mother is the woman. Thus the woman is the man's mother.

questions.questionText: If X is the sister of Y, Y is the daughter of Z, and Z is the wife of W, how is W related to X?
questions.explanation: Z is the wife of W, and Y and X are daughters of Z. Therefore, W is the husband of their mother, making W the father of X.

questions.questionText: Pointing to a lady, a man said, "Her husband's mother is the mother-in-law of my wife." How is the lady related to the man?
questions.explanation: "The mother-in-law of my wife" is the man's own mother. The lady's husband's mother is also the man's mother. This means the lady's husband is the man himself (making the lady his wife) or the man's brother (making the lady his sister-in-law).

questions.questionText: K and L are children of M. If M is the father of K but L is not the son of M, what is L to M?
questions.explanation: L is a biological child of M. Since L is not a son, L must be the daughter of M.

questions.questionText: A is B's sister. C is B's mother. D is C's father. E is D's mother. Then how is A related to D?
questions.explanation: A and B are children of C. D is the father of C. Therefore, A is the daughter of C, making A the granddaughter of D.

questions.questionText: If P + Q means P is the father of Q; P - Q means P is the sister of Q; P * Q means P is the mother of Q. Which represents "J is the aunt of K"?
questions.explanation: J - L (J is sister of L). L + K (L is father of K). Since J is the sister of K's father, J is K's paternal aunt.

questions.questionText: A man said, "This girl is the wife of the grandson of my mother." Who is the man to the girl?
questions.explanation: "The grandson of my mother" is the man's son (or nephew). The wife of the man's son is his daughter-in-law. Therefore, the man is the father-in-law of the girl.

questions.questionText: Deepak has a brother named Anil. Deepak is the son of Prem. Vimal is Prem's father. In terms of relationships, what is Anil to Vimal?
questions.explanation: Deepak and Anil are sons of Prem. Vimal is the father of Prem. Therefore, Anil is the grandson of Vimal.

questions.questionText: A's mother is the sister of B and has a daughter C. How can A be related to B from the given information?
questions.explanation: A is the child of B's sister. The child of a person's sister is their niece (if female) or nephew (if male).

questions.questionText: If "A is the mother of B, C is the son of A, D is the brother of E, E is the daughter of B", who is the grandmother of D?
questions.explanation: B is the parent of E and D (since D is brother of E). A is the mother of B. The mother of D's parent is D's grandmother, so A is the grandmother of D.

questions.questionText: Pointing to a portrait, a girl said, "His mother's only grandson is my brother." Who is the person in the portrait to the girl?
questions.explanation: "My brother" is the grandson of the portrait man's mother. This means the man in the portrait is the father of the girl's brother (and thus the father of the girl herself).

questions.questionText: Ramesh says, "Rekha is the daughter of my father's only daughter." How is Ramesh related to Rekha?
questions.explanation: "My father's only daughter" is Ramesh's sister. Rekha is the daughter of Ramesh's sister. The brother of a child's mother is their maternal uncle. Therefore, Ramesh is Rekha's maternal uncle.

questions.questionText: If P $ Q means P is the father of Q; P # Q means P is the wife of Q; P & Q means P is the sister of Q. In A # B $ C & D, how is A related to D?
questions.explanation: A # B (A is wife of B). B $ C (B is father of C). C & D (C and D are siblings). Since B is father of D and A is wife of B, A is the mother of D.

questions.questionText: Sohan introduces Mohan as the son of the only brother of his father's wife. How are Sohan and Mohan related?
questions.explanation: "His father's wife" is Sohan's mother. "The only brother of his mother" is Sohan's maternal uncle. Mohan is the son of Sohan's maternal uncle. Children of siblings are cousins.

questions.questionText: A family has a man, his wife, their 4 sons, and each son has 1 wife and 2 children. How many members are in this family?
questions.explanation: Man and wife = 2. 4 sons = 4. 4 daughters-in-law (wives) = 4. 4 sons * 2 children each = 8 grandchildren. Total = 2 + 4 + 4 + 8 = 18 members.

questions.questionText: Pointing to a photograph, a woman says, "His sister's father is the only son of my grandfather." How is the woman related to the man in the photograph?
questions.explanation: "His sister's father" is the man's father. "The only son of my grandfather" is the woman's father. Since they share the same father, the woman is the sister of the man in the photograph.

questions.questionText: In a family, A is the brother of B, C is the father of A, D is the brother of E, and E is the daughter of B. How is D related to A?
questions.explanation: E is daughter of B, and D is brother of E; therefore D is the son of B. A is the brother of B. The son of one's sibling is one's nephew. Thus D is A's nephew.

questions.questionText: If P is the brother of the son of Q's son, how is P related to Q?
questions.explanation: "Q's son's son" is Q's grandson. P is the brother of Q's grandson. Therefore, P is also the grandson of Q.

questions.questionText: A man said to a woman, "The only brother of your mother's sister is my father." How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: "Your mother's sister's only brother" is the woman's maternal uncle (if mother has another brother) or the mother's own brother. If that person is the man's father, then the woman's mother and the man's father are siblings, meaning the woman and the man are cousins.

questions.questionText: If A * B means A is the brother of B; A / B means A is the father of B; A + B means A is the sister of B. What does M / N + O * P mean regarding M and P?
questions.optionA: M is the uncle of P
questions.optionB: M is the grandfather of P
questions.optionC: M is the brother of P
questions.optionD: M is the father of P
questions.explanation: M / N (M is father of N). N + O (N is sister of O). O * P (O is brother of P). All N, O, and P are siblings. Since M is the father of N, M is the father of all of them, including P.

questions.questionText: A and B are children of D. Who is the father of A? To answer this, which statement is sufficient: I. C is the mother of A and wife of D. II. D has two children.
questions.explanation: Statement I states C is the wife of D and mother of A. Since C is the mother and D is her husband, D is the father of A. Statement I alone is completely sufficient.

questions.questionText: Pointing to a portrait of a lady, Mohan said, "She has no sisters or daughters, but her mother is the only daughter of my mother." Who is the lady to Mohan?
questions.explanation: "The only daughter of my mother" is Mohan's sister. The lady's mother is Mohan's sister. That makes the lady Mohan's niece? Wait! What if Mohan is a woman? Mohan is traditionally male. If Mohan is male: "only daughter of my mother" is Mohan's sister. The lady's mother is Mohan's sister -> Mohan is maternal uncle, lady is niece. What if the speaker is female (e.g. Mohana): then "only daughter of my mother" is herself, and the lady is her daughter!

questions.questionText: If P is the sister of Q, Q is the husband of R, and S is the mother of P. How is R related to S?
questions.explanation: P and Q are children of S. Q is married to R. The wife of S's son Q is S's daughter-in-law.

questions.questionText: A's father's wife's only brother is X. How is X related to A?
questions.explanation: "A's father's wife" is A's mother. "A's mother's only brother" is A's maternal uncle. Thus X is A's maternal uncle.

questions.questionText: In a joint family, there are 7 members: P, Q, R, S, T, U, V. P is a lawyer and father of T. U is a doctor and mother of V. Q is married to P. How is Q related to T?
questions.explanation: P is the father of T, and Q is married to P. Therefore, Q is the mother of T.

questions.questionText: A woman introduces a man as the son of the only brother of her father. How is the man related to the woman?
questions.explanation: "Her father's only brother" is her paternal uncle. The son of her paternal uncle is her cousin.

questions.questionText: If X + Y means X is the son of Y; X - Y means X is the wife of Y. What does A - B + C mean regarding A and C?
questions.optionA: A is the daughter of C
questions.optionB: A is the mother of C
questions.optionC: A is the daughter-in-law of C
questions.optionD: A is the sister-in-law of C
questions.explanation: B + C means B is the son of C. A - B means A is the wife of B. The wife of C's son is C's daughter-in-law. Therefore, A is the daughter-in-law of C.

questions.questionText: Looking at a photograph, a man says, "I have no brothers or sisters, but that man's father is my father's son." Whose photograph was it?
questions.explanation: "My father's son" with no brothers or sisters means the speaker himself. "That man's father is myself." Therefore, the man in the photograph is his son.

questions.questionText: M is the sister of D. R is the brother of D. F is the father of M and T is the mother of R. How is D related to T?
questions.explanation: F is father and T is mother of M, D, and R. Since D's gender is not specified, D is either the son or daughter of T.

questions.questionText: If A is the brother of B, B is the sister of C, and C is the father of D, how is D related to A?
questions.explanation: A, B, and C are siblings. D is the child of C. The child of one's brother is one's nephew (if male) or niece (if female).

questions.questionText: A family consists of a grandfather, 5 sons, and each son has 3 sons. What is the total number of males in the family?
questions.explanation: 1 grandfather + 5 sons + (5 * 3 = 15 grandsons). Total males = 1 + 5 + 15 = 21 males.

questions.questionText: Pointing to a woman, a man said, "Her only brother's wife is my wife's sister." How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: "My wife's sister" is the man's sister-in-law. The woman's brother is married to the man's sister-in-law. Therefore, the woman's brother is the man's co-brother-in-law, making the woman a sister-in-law.

questions.questionText: If K is the son of G, G is the daughter of H, and H is the husband of J, how is J related to K?
questions.explanation: H is married to J, and G is their daughter. G has a son K. The mother of K's mother G is J, which makes J the maternal grandmother of K.

questions.questionText: A man pointing to a girl says, "She is the daughter of the wife of my only son." What is the girl to the man?
questions.explanation: "The wife of my only son" is the man's daughter-in-law. The daughter of his daughter-in-law and son is his granddaughter.

questions.questionText: If A + B means A is the daughter of B; A - B means A is the brother of B; A * B means A is the wife of B. In the expression X - Y + Z * W, how is X related to W?
questions.explanation: X - Y means X is brother of Y. Y + Z means Y is daughter of Z. Z * W means Z is wife of W (so W is the father). Since X is the brother of W's daughter Y, X is the son of W.
